connector.name: Vectora
connector.registryDescription: AI assistant with RAG, web search, filesystem and memory. MCP sub-agent for Claude Code.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package vectora-agent. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the brunosrz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
env.description: Google Gemini API key (recommended free-tier LLM provider)

env.name: COHERE_API_KEY
env.description: Cohere API key — required for RAG embeddings and reranking

env.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
env.description: Tavily API key — required for web search and URL extraction

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key (optional — alternative LLM provider)

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key (optional — alternative LLM provider)

env.name: LANGSMITH_API_KEY
env.description: LangSmith API key (optional — tracing and observability)
